'''Metal Heads (dangerous)''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest.

==Behavior==
They behave identical to their weaker counterpart the [[Metal Head]]. They have very high defense but no special attacks.

==Strategy==
Due to the fact that they are resistant to knockbacks, you should back up after 2-3 swings.
